items.title_en: MoSoLoco: Monocular 3D Human Localization through Visual Latent Features and Social Context
items.title_zh: MoSoLoco：通过视觉潜特征和社会上下文进行单目3D人体定位
items.abstract_en: Estimating the metric 3D position of people from a monocular camera is important for robot navigation and motion prediction. Lightweight pose-based localizers are attractive for robotic hardware with limited computational resources because they operate on compact 2D keypoints. However, they typically discard the richer visual representations computed by the pose estimator. We introduce MoSoLoco, a per-frame monocular 3D human localizer that combines the pose detector's internal visual features with the detected 2D skeleton, without requiring an additional RGB or depth encoder. MoSoLoco can further incorporate sparse same-frame multi-person context to refine individual position estimates. Experiments on JRDB and NuScenes show that reusing pose-detector representations improves localization, reducing the best JRDB error by approximately 23 percent relative to the strongest evaluated keypoint-based baseline. A sparse social-interaction module incorporates nearby detections from the same image for further refinement. Controlled trajectory-forecasting experiments show downstream benefits, while the complete pipeline remains suitable for efficient Jetson AGX Xavier inference.
items.abstract_zh: 从单目相机估计人员的度量3D位置对于机器人导航和运动预测很重要。轻量级基于位姿的定位器对计算资源有限的机器人硬件具有吸引力，因为它们基于紧凑的2D关键点运行。然而，它们通常会丢弃位姿估计器计算出的更丰富视觉表示。我们引入MoSoLoco，一种逐帧单目3D人体定位器，它将位姿检测器的内部视觉特征与检测到的2D骨架相结合，而无需额外的RGB或深度编码器。MoSoLoco还可以进一步结合同一帧内的稀疏多人上下文来细化个体位置估计。在JRDB和NuScenes上的实验表明，复用位姿检测器表示可改善定位，相对于评估中最强的基于关键点的基线，将最佳JRDB误差降低约23%。稀疏社会交互模块结合同一图像中的附近检测以进一步细化。受控轨迹预测实验显示了下游收益，而完整流程仍适合在Jetson AGX Xavier上进行高效推理。

items.title_en: AC-SMPC: Differentiable Actor--Critic MPC with State Constraints for Safe and Fast Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: AC-SMPC：用于安全快速机器人导航的带状态约束的可微Actor-Critic MPC
items.abstract_en: Achieving safe navigation in confined dynamic environments remains a challenging problem, as robots must balance navigation efficiency with safety. Existing actor--critic MPC architectures typically employ differentiable MPC layers, but this way cannot readily accommodate explicit state constraints, making it intractable to involve collision avoidance within learning-based planning. To address this issue, we propose an actor--critic model predictive control framework with state constraints. We first use vertices to represent the robot and obstacles, and half-spaces to represent the workspace. Based on these, the nonlinear robot dynamics is locally linearized and the hyperplane-based collision avoidance constraints are convexified into the differentiable MPC layer, and then the actor exploits closed-loop feedback to adjust the MPC objective parameters that shape local motion behavior, while the critic evaluates long-term task performance. We further relax the convexified constraints with bounded and penalized slack variables to form an elastic quadratic program, accommodating cases where the local constraint approximations cannot be satisfied simultaneously. Simulation tests and experiments, involving dynamic collision avoidance for multi-robot in narrow cases, illustrate the advantages of the proposed framework in adaptively adjusting the learned policy and improving navigation efficiency over existing approaches while maintaining the motion safety.
items.abstract_zh: 在受限动态环境中实现安全导航仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题，因为机器人必须平衡导航效率与安全性。现有的Actor-Critic MPC架构通常采用可微MPC层，但这种方式无法轻易容纳显式状态约束，使得在基于学习的规划中纳入避撞变得棘手。为解决此问题，我们提出一种带状态约束的Actor-Critic模型预测控制框架。我们首先使用顶点表示机器人和障碍物，并使用半空间表示工作空间。基于这些，非线性机器人动力学被局部线性化，基于超平面的避撞约束被凸化到可微MPC层中，然后Actor利用闭环反馈调整塑造局部运动行为的MPC目标参数，而Critic评估长期任务性能。我们进一步用有界且带惩罚的松弛变量放松凸化约束，形成弹性二次规划，以适应局部约束近似无法同时满足的情况。仿真测试和实验，涉及狭窄情况下多机器人的动态避撞，说明了所提出框架在自适应调整学习策略和提高导航效率方面优于现有方法的优势，同时保持运动安全。

items.title_en: SAFARI: Semantic- And Frontier-driven Autonomous Risk Inspection
items.title_zh: SAFARI：语义与前沿驱动的自主风险巡检
items.abstract_en: Robotic exploration can reduce human exposure to hazardous environments by autonomously searching unknown areas for objects of interest while constructing a complete, risk-aware map. However, existing autonomous exploration approaches typically prioritize geometric coverage or information gain, without explicitly coupling semantic object detection and the risk associated with operating near potentially hazardous objects. Moreover, many systems have been demonstrated primarily in simulation or controlled environments, leaving limited validation of risk-aware semantic exploration in complex, unstructured field settings. To address this gap, we propose SAFARI, a framework that treats object detection as a native channel of a unified probabilistic map, thereby jointly informing exploration and planning with both geometric and semantic evidence. We evaluated SAFARI in 11 missions across three field sites on a quadruped platform. The framework achieved an average coverage of 98.7% of the accessible mission area, without operator intervention for 97.6% of mission time, and detected objects with characteristic dimensions as small as 15cm. Lastly, through ablation studies and a detailed analysis of system behavior, we show that object-size awareness and safety-aware path planning are crucial for effective hazardous-object search.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人探索可以通过自主搜索未知区域中的感兴趣物体，同时构建完整的风险感知地图，从而减少人类暴露于危险环境。然而，现有自主探索方法通常优先考虑几何覆盖或信息增益，而没有明确耦合语义物体检测与在潜在危险物体附近运行相关的风险。此外，许多系统主要在仿真或受控环境中演示，导致风险感知语义探索在复杂、非结构化现场环境中的验证有限。为弥补这一空白，我们提出SAFARI，一个将物体检测视为统一概率地图原生通道的框架，从而利用几何和语义证据共同指导探索与规划。我们在四足平台上跨越三个现场地点的11次任务中评估了SAFARI。该框架实现了可达任务区域平均98.7%的覆盖率，在97.6%的任务时间内无需操作员干预，并检测到特征尺寸小至15cm的物体。最后，通过消融研究和系统行为的详细分析，我们表明物体尺寸感知和安全感知路径规划对于有效的危险物体搜索至关重要。

items.title_en: Tension Tells the Tail: Cable-Obstacle Interaction Sensing for Tethered Mobile Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: 张力揭示尾端：面向系留移动机器人导航的缆绳—障碍物交互感知
items.abstract_en: Tethered mobile robots can sustain long-duration operation through continuous power supply and stable communication via their cables. However, cable-environment interaction causes unintended obstacle displacement, cable snagging or entanglement, and even cable damage, leading to mission failure. To assess the risk of individual cable-obstacle contacts, this study investigates cable tension as a sensing modality for estimating whether a contacted obstacle is movable or non-movable. We conducted experiments with a tethered mobile robot and collected tension data while varying robot velocity, contact angle between the obstacle and cable, obstacle mass, and obstacle side-surface material. The results show that obstacle movability is characterized by the initial tension rise and, more importantly, by whether the tension relaxes or remains high after its peak. Based on these observations, we select six features from the tension profiles and train a logistic-regression classifier using 117 labeled trials. The proposed method distinguishes movable and non-movable cases with a balanced accuracy of 95.5% after 30 cm of post-contact travel. These results demonstrate the potential of cable tension for risk assessment of cable-obstacle interactions and provide a step toward online, cable-aware autonomous navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 系留移动机器人可通过缆绳持续供电和稳定通信来维持长时间运行。然而，缆绳与环境的交互会导致障碍物发生非预期位移、缆绳被勾挂或缠绕，甚至缆绳损坏，从而导致任务失败。为评估单次缆绳—障碍物接触的风险，本研究将缆绳张力作为一种传感模态，用于估计被接触障碍物是可移动的还是不可移动的。我们使用系留移动机器人开展实验，并在改变机器人速度、障碍物与缆绳之间的接触角、障碍物质量以及障碍物侧面材料的情况下采集张力数据。结果表明，障碍物可移动性可由初始张力上升来表征，更重要的是，可由张力在峰值之后是松弛还是保持高位来表征。基于这些观察，我们从张力曲线中选择六个特征，并使用117次带标签试验训练逻辑回归分类器。所提方法在接触后行进30 cm后以95.5%的平衡准确率区分可移动与不可移动情形。这些结果展示了缆绳张力用于缆绳—障碍物交互风险评估的潜力，并朝着在线、缆绳感知的自主导航迈进一步。

items.title_en: RTISSLAM-3D: Full 6-DoF SLAM With an In-Air 3D Imaging Sonar
items.title_zh: RTISSLAM-3D：使用空中三维成像声呐的全6自由度SLAM
items.abstract_en: Echolocating bats navigate dense forests using sonar alone, and in-air 3D imaging sonars now capture the entire frontal hemisphere with every pulse. Sonar SLAM, however, has so far been planar: current systems estimate a 2D trajectory and discard the elevation information in the sonar images, an assumption that does not hold on rough and sloped terrain such as a forest floor. In this paper, we introduce RTISSLAM-3D, a novel 6-DoF SLAM system for a wheeled robot that carries an in-air 3D imaging sonar, an IMU and wheel encoders. A CFAR detector on the sphere reduces every sonar image to a sparse set of 3D detections, which we use for a 3D acoustic odometry that models the shape of the sonar beam, for place recognition with polar submap descriptors, and for the verification of loop closures by 3D registration, all combined in a 6-DoF pose graph with attitude factors. We evaluated RTISSLAM-3D on a 545m drive through a forest, with a 3D lidar SLAM as reference. The loop closures reduced the horizontal error of the acoustic odometry from 1.74m to 0.28m, with a height error of 0.12m, and 94.6% of the resulting 3D sonar map lies within 0.3 m of the lidar map.
items.abstract_zh: 回声定位蝙蝠仅依靠声呐就能在茂密森林中导航，而如今的空中三维成像声呐可在每次脉冲中捕获整个前半球。然而，声呐SLAM迄今仍是平面化的：当前系统估计二维轨迹并丢弃声呐图像中的高度信息，这一假设在崎岖和倾斜地形（如森林地面）上并不成立。本文介绍RTISSLAM-3D，这是一种新型6自由度SLAM系统，面向搭载空中三维成像声呐、IMU和轮式编码器的轮式机器人。球面上的CFAR检测器将每帧声呐图像简化为稀疏的三维检测集合，我们将其用于：建模声呐波束形状的三维声学里程计、使用极坐标子图描述子的位置识别，以及通过三维配准验证闭环；所有这些都结合在带有姿态因子的6自由度位姿图中。我们在穿越森林的545 m行驶中评估RTISSLAM-3D，并以三维激光雷达SLAM作为参考。闭环将声学里程计的水平误差从1.74 m降低到0.28 m，高度误差为0.12 m，所得三维声呐地图中有94.6%位于激光雷达地图的0.3 m范围内。

items.title_en: An Open MuJoCo Simulation Framework for a Quadrotor Carrying a Tendon-Driven Soft Continuum Arm
items.title_zh: 一种用于携带腱驱动软连续体臂的四旋翼的开源MuJoCo仿真框架
items.abstract_en: Combining aerial robots with soft continuum manipulators promises safe, compliant interaction with the environment, but the coupled dynamics of a free-flying base and a highly deformable, underactuated arm are difficult to study without a suitable simulator. This paper describes an open-source simulation framework, built on the MuJoCo physics engine, for a quadrotor that carries a tendon-driven soft continuum arm underneath its body. The arm is modelled as a pseudo-rigid-body chain of twelve segments joined by pairs of orthogonal compliant hinges. Three tendons, spaced \SI{120}{\degree} apart and routed through every segment, bend it in any direction. A geometric tracking controller on $SE(3)$ flies the vehicle; its rotor allocation matrix is generated directly from the model description. A closed-form tendon-tension allocation keeps every tension within its limits and gives the same bending moment in every direction. We report the full set of modelling choices and parameters, and we evaluate the framework in four simulated scenarios: a \SI{36}{\second} mission with a figure-eight and a tendon-driven tip sweep, an attitude-gain study, a quasi-static characterization of the bending workspace, and an impulsive disturbance applied to the arm tip. With the nominal gains the vehicle tracks the mission with \SI{3.1}{\centi\meter} RMS position error while the arm tip swings up to \SI{37}{\centi\meter} from the body axis. The gain study shows that a low-bandwidth attitude loop lets the arm excite sustained oscillations. The simulation runs about $15\times$ faster than real time on a laptop CPU. All models, controllers and scripts that reproduce the figures are released.
items.abstract_zh: 将空中机器人与软连续体操纵器相结合，有望实现安全、柔顺的环境交互，但自由飞行基座与高度可变形、欠驱动臂的耦合动力学，在没有合适仿真器的情况下难以研究。本文介绍一个基于MuJoCo物理引擎的开源仿真框架，用于四旋翼在其机体下方携带腱驱动软连续体臂。该臂被建模为由十二段组成的伪刚体链，各段由成对正交柔性铰链连接。三根腱彼此间隔120°并穿过每一段，可在任意方向使其弯曲。$SE(3)$上的几何跟踪控制器控制飞行器飞行；其旋翼分配矩阵直接由模型描述生成。闭式腱张力分配使每根腱的张力保持在其限制内，并在每个方向上给出相同的弯曲力矩。我们报告完整的建模选择与参数，并在四个仿真场景中评估该框架：包含八字形轨迹和腱驱动末端扫掠的36 s任务、姿态增益研究、弯曲工作空间的准静态表征，以及施加于臂端的脉冲扰动。在标称增益下，飞行器以3.1 cm RMS位置误差跟踪任务，而臂端从机体轴摆出可达37 cm。增益研究表明，低带宽姿态环会让臂激发持续振荡。该仿真在笔记本电脑CPU上运行速度约为实时的15倍。所有复现图表的模型、控制器和脚本均已发布。

items.title_en: C2Flight: A Closed-Loop Co-Simulation Framework for Early-Stage Evaluation of Heterogeneous UAV Computing Systems
items.title_zh: C2Flight：用于异构无人机计算系统早期评估的闭环协同仿真框架
items.abstract_en: Early-stage design of heterogeneous UAV computing systems requires evaluating how algorithm, hardware, communication, and system topology affect closed-loop flight before the complete system is available. However, design choices interact through the robotic feedback loop, making task performance difficult to predict from isolated component metrics, while existing execution-driven approaches postpone system-level design feedback until the computing system is integrated. This work presents C2Flight, a closed-loop co-simulation framework that represents target systems as parameterized dataflow graphs and integrates models of hardware under design with independently accessible physical hardware through a unified node interface. Its graph runtime captures the combined effects of buffering, activation, resource sharing, communication, and local timing on closed-loop flight behavior. Validation against onboard and wireless offboard physical computing pipelines confirms its timing fidelity and closed-loop prediction accuracy. Two case studies demonstrate early-stage exploration of deployment and accelerator bit-width choices. These results show that C2Flight exposes system-level design trade-offs before full-system integration, enabling rapid early-stage design refinement.
items.abstract_zh: 异构无人机计算系统的早期设计需要在完整系统可用之前评估算法、硬件、通信和系统拓扑如何影响闭环飞行。然而，设计选择通过机器人反馈回路相互作用，使得任务性能难以从孤立的组件指标预测；同时，现有执行驱动方法将系统级设计反馈推迟到计算系统集成之后。本文提出C2Flight，一种闭环协同仿真框架，将目标系统表示为参数化数据流图，并通过统一节点接口将设计中的硬件模型与可独立访问的物理硬件集成。其图运行时捕获缓冲、激活、资源共享、通信和局部时序对闭环飞行行为的综合影响。针对机载和无线离板物理计算流水线的验证确认了其时序保真度和闭环预测准确性。两个案例研究展示了对部署和加速器位宽选择的早期探索。这些结果表明，C2Flight在完整系统集成之前揭示系统级设计权衡，从而实现快速的早期设计改进。

items.title_en: Real-world Latency Analysis of Vehicular Visible Light Communication with Multiple LED Transmitters and an Event-Based Camera
items.title_zh: 多LED发射机与事件相机车联网可见光通信的真实场景时延分析
items.abstract_en: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution, low latency, and wide dynamic range, making them promising receivers for visible light communication (VLC) in vehicle-to-everything (V2X) applications. This work presents an event-camera-based VLC system addressing three key challenges: bandwidth saturation, multi-transmitter reception, and latency characterization. We adopt a positive-event-only mode and design a protocol that suppresses event generation while maintaining communication distance and a wide field of view. We also propose a method to identify multiple transmitters and demonstrate simultaneous reception from up to three LEDs. Finally, we evaluate end-to-end latency in real vehicular scenarios and show that the system meets cooperative perception requirements. These results demonstrate that event-camera-based VLC is a feasible complement to existing V2X technologies (e.g., RF).
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机具备高时间分辨率、低时延和宽动态范围，是车联网（V2X）中可见光通信（VLC）颇具前景的接收器。本文提出一种基于事件相机的VLC系统，应对带宽饱和、多发射机接收与时延刻画三大挑战。作者采用仅正事件模式，并设计协议以抑制事件产生，同时保持通信距离与宽视场；提出多发射机识别方法，演示了最多三盏LED的同时接收；最后在真实车辆场景中评估端到端时延，表明系统满足协同感知的需求。结果说明基于事件相机的VLC可作为现有V2X技术（如射频）的可行补充。
items.highlight_zh: 事件相机车联网VLC实测端到端时延，可支持三灯同时接收
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：车与车、车与路之间的通信（V2X）目前主要靠射频，但射频在拥堵信道和高密度场景下会受限。可见光通信可作为补充——车灯本来就在发光。问题是：普通相机帧率太低、延迟太大；而事件相机虽然响应极快（微秒级）、动态范围宽，用在车上却有三个实际障碍：事件输出速率太高会把带宽“撑爆”；一辆车视野里往往有多盏灯同时发送，怎么区分；以及在真实道路条件下端到端到底有多快，此前不清楚。

二、用了什么方法：作者采用“只取正事件”的工作模式（只响应变亮），并设计了一套协议主动抑制事件产生量，从而在保住通信距离和大视场的前提下避免数据洪流。针对多发射机，提出用空间位置区分不同LED的方法，实现最多三盏LED同时接收。最后搭建真实车载场景，测量从发到收的端到端时延。

三、有什么结果：系统能够同时接收三盏LED的信号，且端到端时延满足协同感知（车辆间共享感知数据）的实时性要求，证明该方案在真实车辆场景中可用。

四、为何重要：它把事件相机VLC从实验室演示推进到真实车辆场景，系统性地回答了“带宽够不够、多灯能不能分、快不快”这三个决定能否落地的关键问题，说明光通信可以成为射频V2X的实用补充。

items.title_en: An Open-Source Research Platform for Embedded Visible Light Networking
items.abstract_en: Despite the growing interest in Visible Light Communication (VLC), a reference networking platform based on commercial off-the-shelf components is not available yet. An open-source platform would lower the barriers to entry to VLC network research and help the VLC community gain momentum. We introduce OpenVLC, an open-source VLC research platform based on software-defined implementation. Built around a credit-card-sized embedded Linux platform with a simple opto-electronic transceiver front-end, OpenVLC offers a basic physical layer, a set of essential medium access primitives, as well as interoperability with Internet protocols. We investigate the performance of OpenVLC and show examples of how it can be used along with standard network diagnostics tools. Our software-defined implementation can currently reach throughput in the order of the basic rate of IEEE 802.15.7 standard. We discuss several techniques that researchers and engineers could introduce to improve the performance of OpenVLC and envision several directions that can benefit from OpenVLC by adopting it as a reference platform.
items.title_zh: 一个面向嵌入式可见光网络的的开源研究平台
items.abstract_zh: 尽管可见光通信（VLC）受到越来越多的关注，但基于商用现成组件的参考网络平台仍未出现。一个开源平台将降低VLC网络研究的入门门槛，并有助于VLC社区形成声势。我们推出OpenVLC——一个基于软件定义实现的开源VLC研究平台。OpenVLC围绕信用卡大小的嵌入式Linux平台构建，配有简单的光电收发前端，提供基础物理层、一组必要的介质访问原语，以及与互联网协议的互操作性。我们考察了OpenVLC的性能，并展示其如何与标准网络诊断工具配合使用的示例。我们的软件定义实现目前可达到与IEEE 802.15.7标准基本速率相当量级的吞吐量。我们讨论了研究人员与工程师可用于提升OpenVLC性能的若干技术，并展望了采用它作为参考平台而受益的多个方向。
items.highlight_zh: 推出开源软件定义可见光通信研究平台OpenVLC
items.digest_zh:
本研究要解决的问题是：可见光通信（VLC）研究热度上升，但社区缺少一个基于商用现成器件、可复现的参考网络平台，导致入门门槛高、各家实验难以对比。

作者的做法是构建 OpenVLC：硬件上采用信用卡大小的嵌入式 Linux 单板计算机，外接一个简单的光电收发前端；软件上采用软件定义的方式，自行实现基础物理层、若干必要的介质访问控制原语，并让系统能够与标准互联网协议互通，从而把 VLC 链路接入常规网络栈。

在结果方面，作者测量了 OpenVLC 的实际性能，并用标准网络诊断工具做了演示性实验，说明该平台可直接沿用现有网络调试方法；当前吞吐量达到 IEEE 802.15.7 标准基本速率的量级，属于可用但仍有提升空间的原型水平。文中还讨论了研究者可采用的若干性能改进手段。

其重要性在于：开源与低成本降低了 VLC 组网研究的门槛，使更多团队能复现与比较实验结果，有助于该领域形成共同基准；同时软件定义的架构便于快速试验新协议与新算法。它为可见光通信从点对点链路走向真正的网络化研究提供了可共享的起点。

optical_review.reason_zh: OpenVLC早期开放原型把OOK、曼彻斯特编码、介质访问与网络接口连成可运行系统，适合参考低成本嵌入式可见光链路的分层实现。

items.title_en: Visual-Inertial RGB-D SLAM with Encoders for a Differential Wheeled Robot
items.title_zh: 面向差速轮式机器人、带编码器的视觉-惯性RGB-D SLAM
items.abstract_en: Recent years have seen multiple impressive results in visual-inertial odometry (VIO) techniques, by which accurate state estimation can be achieved via the extended Kalman filter (EKF) or nonlinear optimization. However, these approaches are rarely open source, and they tend to fail in real experiments due to the temporary lack of feature points and fast motion. Therefore, in this study, we used encoders to overcome the temporary failure of purely vision-based simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Here, we propose a generative measurement model for encoders and derive an expression for the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate and necessary Jacobians for optimization. We use our theory to present a novel tightly coupled visual-inertial encoder RGB-Depth (RGB-D) SLAM system. Tests on our system on an in-house dataset confirmed that our modeling effort led to accurate (with a root mean squared error (RMSE) of approximately 2-7 cm) and robust state estimation in real time. The source code and our dataset containing the encoder information have been published for verification.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，视觉-惯性里程计（VIO）技术取得了多项令人印象深刻的结果，可通过扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）或非线性优化实现准确的状态估计。然而，这些方法很少开源，并且由于特征点暂时缺失和快速运动，往往在实际实验中失败。因此，在本研究中，我们使用编码器来克服纯视觉同时定位与建图（SLAM）的暂时失效。在此，我们提出一种编码器的生成式测量模型，并推导最大后验（MAP）估计的表达式以及优化所需的雅可比矩阵。我们利用该理论提出一种新型紧耦合视觉-惯性-编码器RGB-深度（RGB-D）SLAM系统。在自建数据集上对我们系统的测试证实，我们的建模工作实现了准确（均方根误差（RMSE）约为2–7 cm）且鲁棒的实时状态估计。源代码以及包含编码器信息的数据集已发布以供验证。
items.comment: 11 pages. Author-accepted manuscript of the article published in IEEE Sensors Journal, 2022

items.title_en: Cross-Embodiment Motion Planning by Coupling Body-Agnostic World Model with Differentiable Ego-Dynamics
items.title_zh: 通过耦合本体无关世界模型与可微自运动动力学实现跨具身运动规划
items.abstract_en: Motion planning in clutter is embodiment-specific: the feasible free space and reachable commands depend on each robot's geometry and dynamics. Existing cross-embodiment policies output normalized commands that disregard these differences, or compensate through per-robot training and distillation. World models can in principle pool cross-embodiment data, yet command-conditioned models bind their latent dynamics to a single action space, while pose-conditioned models omit the mapping from commands to body-specific motion. On flat ground, however, embodiment affects the planner's observations only through the camera ego-motion. This letter proposes Hourglass, an hourglass-shaped architecture that factorizes cross-embodiment motion planning at this interface: a body-agnostic world model and each robot's differentiable ego-dynamics, which map commands to that ego-motion, are coupled only through it. The world model is trained on data pooled across embodiments and camera mounts; each robot's ego-dynamics is a reduced-order template with identified physical parameters. A generalist parameter-conditioned policy is learned once at this junction: each imagined step rolls out the template and then the world model, and imagination training through each robot's template makes the policy body-aware. On seven simulated robots of five locomotion types, the generalist policy outperforms imitation-learning and diffusion-policy baselines on the same world model by 3.8--10.6 percentage points in success rate and matches per-robot specialists without dedicated training, while approaching its parameter-conditioned MPPI teacher within 1.4--2.8 points without an online map. After three minutes of teleoperated driving for identification, the synthetic-data-trained model transfers zero-shot to a real skid-steer robot unseen in training, navigating unseen indoor scenes.
items.abstract_zh: 杂乱环境中的运动规划与具身相关：可行自由空间和可达指令取决于每个机器人的几何形状与动力学。现有跨具身策略输出忽略这些差异的归一化指令，或通过逐机器人训练和蒸馏进行补偿。世界模型原则上可以汇集跨具身数据，但指令条件化模型将其潜在动力学绑定到单一动作空间，而位姿条件化模型省略了从指令到本体特定运动的映射。然而，在平坦地面上，具身仅通过相机自运动影响规划器的观测。本文提出Hourglass，一种沙漏形架构，在该接口处对跨具身运动规划进行因子化：本体无关世界模型与每个机器人的可微自运动动力学（将指令映射到该自运动）仅通过该接口耦合。世界模型在汇集自不同具身和相机安装方式的数据上训练；每个机器人的自运动动力学是经过物理参数辨识的降阶模板。通用参数条件化策略在该连接处一次性学习：每个想象步骤先展开模板，再展开世界模型，而通过每个机器人模板进行的想象训练使策略具备本体感知能力。在五种运动类型的七个仿真机器人上，该通用策略在成功率上比同一世界模型上的模仿学习和扩散策略基线高3.8–10.6个百分点，并在无需专门训练的情况下达到逐机器人专家策略的水平，同时在无在线地图时将其与参数条件化MPPI教师策略的差距缩小到1.4–2.8个百分点。在用于辨识的三分钟遥操作驾驶之后，经合成数据训练的模型零样本迁移到训练中未见过的真实滑移转向机器人，并在未见过的室内场景中导航。
items.comment: 8 pages

items.title_en: CONSORT: Uncertainty-Constrained Multi-Robot Planning for Cooperative Localization in GPS-Denied Environments
items.title_zh: CONSORT：GPS拒止环境下面向协同定位的不确定性约束多机器人规划
items.abstract_en: Centralized multi-agent path planning with cooperative localization in GPS-denied environments is generally computationally intractable when formulated in full belief space due to tightly coupled uncertainty dynamics. Prior work typically approximates belief dynamics or restricts inter-agent coupling. This work examines a multi-agent planning problem in which a primary agent must reach a goal in minimum time subject to a chance-constrained collision-avoidance requirement and a terminal bound on localization uncertainty. We obtain a tractable surrogate of the underlying belief-space problem by optimizing over the mean-state trajectories of all agents and propagating covariance for terminal constraint evaluation only. We propose CONSORT (Cooperative Navigation with Support-Optimized Routing and Trajectories), a discrete-to-continuous pipeline combining hexagonal-grid joint search with spline-based trajectory refinement. Across 50 randomized scenarios, the planners separate as the terminal uncertainty bound tightens, with CONSORT solving 80% of scenarios where the strongest baseline solves 54%, at comparable path length. In marine simulations, with the plans executed under feedback control on an independently developed factor-graph estimate, the trajectories remain collision-free and their terminal uncertainty falls within 6% of the planner's prediction.
items.abstract_zh: 在GPS拒止环境中，当以完整置信空间形式建模时，由于不确定性动力学强耦合，带协同定位的集中式多智能体路径规划通常计算上不可处理。先前工作通常近似置信动力学或限制智能体间耦合。本文研究一个多智能体规划问题：主智能体必须在机会约束避碰要求和定位不确定性终端界限约束下，以最短时间到达目标。我们仅对所有智能体的均值状态轨迹进行优化，并仅为终端约束评估传播协方差，从而获得底层置信空间问题的可处理替代模型。我们提出CONSORT（Cooperative Navigation with Support-Optimized Routing and Trajectories，支持优化路由与轨迹的协同导航），一种将六边形网格联合搜索与基于样条的轨迹细化相结合的离散到连续流水线。在50个随机场景中，随着终端不确定性界限收紧，各规划器表现分化；在路径长度相当的情况下，CONSORT求解了80%的场景，而最强基线求解54%。在海洋仿真中，当规划在独立开发的因子图估计上通过反馈控制执行时，轨迹保持无碰撞，其终端不确定性落在规划器预测值的6%以内。
items.comment: 8 pages, 8 figures

items.title_en: Capability-Conditioned Graph Control Barrier Functions for Zero-Shot Safe Navigation of Heterogeneous Mobile Robot Teams
items.title_zh: 用于异构移动机器人团队零样本安全导航的能力条件化图控制屏障函数
items.abstract_en: Multi-robot systems are increasingly deployed as heterogeneous fleets with diverse kinematic and actuation capabilities. While graph control barrier function (GCBF) methods provide a scalable framework for decentralized safe control, existing approaches typically assume homogeneous robot dynamics. Methods that directly encode robot classes can distinguish known types, but do not represent state-dependent motion capabilities or naturally transfer to unseen robot models. To address this challenge, we propose the Capability-Conditioned Heterogeneous Graph Control Barrier Function (CC-HGCBF), defined in a shared second-order reference-point operational space. This formulation provides a common geometric representation of safety across heterogeneous robots while retaining their model-specific dynamics and admissible control constraints. To enable zero-shot transfer, we introduce the Radial Capability Field (RCF), a compact, fixed-dimensional representation of each robot's state-dependent finite-horizon reachable velocity set. Conditioning the shared graph barrier and decentralized policy on the RCF enables them to adapt to changes in robot state, kinematic constraints, and control limits without relying on predefined robot identities. We jointly train the barrier and policy using proactive safety labeling and neural CBF-QP supervision, and evaluate them on mixed teams containing both seen and unseen robot models. Experiments demonstrate scalable safe coordination and zero-shot transfer to robot models and capability variations withheld during training. Physical-robot experiments further demonstrate zero-shot deployment to unseen kinematic models without retraining.
items.abstract_zh: 多机器人系统正日益以具有多样运动学和驱动能力的异构车队形式部署。尽管图控制屏障函数（GCBF）方法为分散式安全控制提供了可扩展框架，现有方法通常假设机器人动力学同质。直接编码机器人类别的方法能够区分已知类型，但不能表示状态相关的运动能力，也不能自然迁移到未见过的机器人模型。为应对该挑战，我们提出能力条件化异构图控制屏障函数（CC-HGCBF），定义在共享的二阶参考点操作空间中。该形式为异构机器人提供了共同的安全几何表示，同时保留其模型特定的动力学和容许控制约束。为实现零样本迁移，我们引入径向能力场（RCF），这是一种对每个机器人状态相关的有限时域可达速度集的紧凑、固定维表示。将共享图屏障和分散式策略以RCF为条件，使其能够适应机器人状态、运动学约束和控制限制的变化，而无需依赖预定义的机器人身份。我们使用主动安全标注和神经CBF-QP监督联合训练屏障和策略，并在包含已见和未见机器人模型的混合团队上评估。实验展示了可扩展的安全协调以及对训练期间未提供的机器人模型和能力变化的零样本迁移。物理机器人实验进一步展示了无需重新训练即可零样本部署到未见的运动学模型。

items.title_en: Learning Direct Control from Optimization for Dynamic Target Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向动态目标跟踪的从优化学习直接控制
items.abstract_en: Dynamic target tracking requires a mobile robot to maintain target visibility while navigating obstacles with smooth, feasible controls. Online trajectory optimization explicitly encodes these objectives but requires repeated numerical solving, whereas waypoint-based neural policies separate geometric prediction from control execution. We introduce LECO, a framework that transfers tracking optimization into offline learning of a direct-control policy. LECO predicts control sequences and maps them to trajectories through a differentiable kinematic model, allowing trajectory-level objectives to directly guide control learning. A decaying expert-guidance curriculum initializes effective tracking behavior and progressively shifts learning toward these task objectives. At deployment, a predictive safety lock checks short-horizon obstacle clearance and invokes a classical planning and control fallback when the predicted motion is unsafe or the target prediction is invalid. Across three simulated obstacle densities, LECO reduces root-mean-square linear jerk by 14.1--31.2\% relative to the best competing method for this metric and achieves the highest tracking success rate, with per-cycle computation times of 4.25--5.63\,ms. Experiments on two robot platforms further demonstrate tracking through indoor narrow passages and outdoor forest environments. These results demonstrate that learning direct control from optimization enables smooth and robust dynamic target tracking.
items.abstract_zh: 动态目标跟踪要求移动机器人在避障的同时保持目标可见，并以平滑、可行的控制进行导航。在线轨迹优化显式编码这些目标，但需要反复数值求解；而基于路点的神经策略将几何预测与控制执行分离。我们提出LECO，一个将跟踪优化迁移为直接控制策略离线学习的框架。LECO预测控制序列，并通过可微分运动学模型将其映射为轨迹，使轨迹级目标能够直接指导控制学习。一种衰减的专家引导课程初始化有效跟踪行为，并逐步将学习转向这些任务目标。部署时，预测安全锁检查短时域障碍物净空，并在预测运动不安全或目标预测无效时调用经典规划与控制回退。在三种仿真障碍物密度下，LECO相对于该指标上最佳竞争方法将均方根线性加加速度降低14.1--31.2%，并取得最高跟踪成功率，每周期计算时间为4.25--5.63 ms。在两个机器人平台上的实验进一步展示了室内狭窄通道和室外森林环境中的跟踪。这些结果表明，从优化中学习直接控制能够实现平滑且稳健的动态目标跟踪。

items.title_en: Physical AI for Intralogistics: Benchmarking the NVIDIA Sim-to-Real Ecosystem for Cosmos-Enhanced COMPASS Navigation on Industrial Mobile Robots
items.title_zh: 面向内部物流的物理AI：在工业移动机器人上对Cosmos增强的COMPASS导航的NVIDIA仿真到现实生态系统进行基准测试
items.abstract_en: Classical robot navigation stacks are reliable but often require re-engineering for each new robot type and site. Learning-based navigation shifts this effort from hand-tuned parameters to data generation and training, where a policy adapts to each new embodiment or facility by fine-tuning in simulation. Whether policies adapted this way stay reliable on real industrial robots has seen little systematic testing. We study this for NVIDIA's X-Mobility and COMPASS workflow for training learned navigation policies on Idealworks robots. In simulation, we extend the COMPASS benchmark with two embodiments, the differential-drive iw$\mkern-1.5mu.\mkern-1.5mu$hub and an omnidirectional Humanoid Mobile Platform (HMP), and with a digital twin of the Idealworks R&D center. For the real world, we fine-tune X-Mobility on data from this digital twin, with and without sim-to-real variants generated by NVIDIA Cosmos, train COMPASS on top of it from scratch in the digital twin, deploy the resulting policies on the iw$\mkern-1.5mu.\mkern-1.5mu$hub's onboard Jetson AGX Xavier, and benchmark them in the Idealworks R&D center against COMPASS trained only on NVIDIA's environments and the existing Idealworks navigation stack on task success, efficiency, safety, smoothness and onboard compute. Running every static scenario both in a digital-twin replica and in the real facility measures the sim-to-real gap and how far Cosmos-augmented data closes it. Training in the digital twin with Cosmos sim-to-real augmentation raises the real-world success rate of learned navigation from 65.3% to 91.7% across four scenarios and nearly halves its weighted travel time compared with simulation-only training, bringing it within 8.3 points of the production navigation stack, fully onboard; with an integrated global planner, it also reaches far, occluded goals in every trial.
items.abstract_zh: 经典机器人导航栈可靠，但通常需要为每种新机器人类型和站点重新工程化。基于学习的导航将这项工作从手工调参转向数据生成与训练，其中策略通过在仿真中微调来适应每种新的具身形态或设施。以这种方式适应的策略能否在真实工业机器人上保持可靠，尚缺乏系统测试。我们针对NVIDIA的X-Mobility与COMPASS工作流研究这一问题，该工作流用于在Idealworks机器人上训练学习型导航策略。在仿真中，我们用两种具身形态——差速驱动iw.hub和全向Humanoid Mobile Platform（HMP）——以及Idealworks研发中心的数字孪生扩展了COMPASS基准。在真实世界中，我们在来自该数字孪生的数据上微调X-Mobility，分别使用和不使用由NVIDIA Cosmos生成的仿真到现实变体；在此基础上于数字孪生中从头训练COMPASS；将所得策略部署到iw.hub的板载Jetson AGX Xavier上；并在Idealworks研发中心中，在任务成功率、效率、安全性、平滑性和板载计算方面，将其与仅在NVIDIA环境中训练的COMPASS以及现有Idealworks导航栈进行基准测试。在数字孪生副本和真实设施中运行每个静态场景，可测量仿真到现实差距以及Cosmos增强数据将其缩小到何种程度。在数字孪生中使用Cosmos仿真到现实增强进行训练，使学习型导航在四个场景中的真实世界成功率从65.3%提高到91.7%，与仅仿真训练相比，其加权行驶时间几乎减半，使其在完全板载情况下与生产导航栈相差8.3个百分点以内；配合集成的全局规划器，它还能在每次试验中到达远处被遮挡的目标。

items.title_en: ARC-SORT: Adaptive, Robust, Compensated Multi-Object Tracking with Interacting Multiple Models
items.title_zh: ARC-SORT：基于交互式多模型的自适应、鲁棒、补偿式多目标跟踪
items.abstract_en: Multi-object tracking in sports broadcasts is hard for two reasons: athletes move fast and change direction abruptly, and the camera pans and zooms at the same time. We present ARC-SORT (Adaptive, Robust, Compensated SORT), a tracking-by-detection tracker that trains nothing and runs in real time. Its design rule: the tracker measures its own uncertainty, and that measurement decides how it acts. An Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) Kalman filter gives every track a predictive covariance, and we turn it into a per-track search region: the less reliable the motion prediction, the larger the region in which a detection may match (uncertainty-adaptive Expansion IoU, EIoU). On identical inputs, this continuous coupling is what matters: the same covariance used as a hard Mahalanobis gate hurts at every threshold we swept, and richer covariance summaries add nothing measurable. When two tracks cross, the assignment cost itself reports whether the decision was close. ARC-SORT keeps such pairs under review and applies at most one corrective identity swap once post-crossing appearance evidence shows the first decision was wrong; this adds +1.0 HOTA (higher order tracking accuracy) on both the SportsMOT and DanceTrack test sets at under a millisecond per frame. For players who leave the frame for seconds, motion extrapolation carries no information, so our offline re-identification drops the usual motion gate and links tracklets by appearance alone. ARC-SORT reaches 81.82 HOTA on the SportsMOT test set with the fewest identity switches of the 69 leaderboard entries as of August 2026 and tied-third multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA, 97.09), and 62.1 HOTA on DanceTrack test with the same association settings. On Deep-EIoU's public detections and embeddings it reaches 80.31 HOTA, +3.1 over Deep-EIoU. It runs at about 50 frames per second on a laptop RTX 3060 GPU. Code will be released.
items.abstract_zh: 体育转播中的多目标跟踪困难有两点原因：运动员移动快且突然改变方向，同时摄像机还会平移和变焦。我们提出ARC-SORT（Adaptive, Robust, Compensated SORT），一种无需训练且实时运行的检测跟踪器。其设计规则是：跟踪器测量自身不确定性，并由该测量决定其行为方式。交互式多模型（IMM）卡尔曼滤波器为每个轨迹提供预测协方差，我们将其转化为每条轨迹的搜索区域：运动预测越不可靠，检测可匹配的区域就越大（不确定性自适应扩展IoU，EIoU）。在相同输入上，这种连续耦合才是关键：将同一协方差用作硬马氏门控，在我们扫描的每个阈值下都会造成损害，而更丰富的协方差摘要没有可测量的增益。当两条轨迹交叉时，分配代价本身会报告该决策是否接近。ARC-SORT将此类配对置于复核之下，并在交叉后外观证据表明首次决策错误时，至多应用一次纠正性身份交换；这在SportsMOT和DanceTrack测试集上均增加+1.0 HOTA（高阶跟踪准确率），每帧耗时低于1毫秒。对于离开画面数秒的球员，运动外推不携带信息，因此我们的离线重识别放弃通常的运动门控，仅按外观链接轨迹片段。截至2026年8月，ARC-SORT在SportsMOT测试集上达到81.82 HOTA，在69个排行榜条目中身份切换最少，多目标跟踪准确率（MOTA，97.09）并列第三；在DanceTrack测试集上以相同关联设置达到62.1 HOTA。在Deep-EIoU的公开检测和嵌入上，它达到80.31 HOTA，比Deep-EIoU高+3.1。它在笔记本电脑RTX 3060 GPU上以约50帧/秒运行。代码将发布。

items.title_en: LABIT: Long-Horizon Robotic Assembly Benchmark for Industrial Tasks
items.title_zh: LABIT：面向工业任务的长时域机器人装配基准
items.abstract_en: Robot learning has undergone significant advancements in the domain of compliant control and robotic assembly. The development of novel methodologies has transcended the capacity to address discrete tasks, such as grasping or inserting, and has evolved to encompass the comprehensive construction of entire assemblies. Conventional benchmarks, which are predominantly focused on single tasks, are no longer adequate to address the complexity and interconnected nature of modern manufacturing processes. Consequently, the necessity for benchmarks to encompass a broader spectrum of assembly and subassembly steps is becoming apparent. In light of these developments, we propose LABIT, an industrial robotic assembly benchmark for long-horizon manipulation. This benchmark encompasses DIN-norm assembly tasks, including screwing, placing, inserting, and snapping, under both high and low tolerance conditions. The successive nature of these assembly steps implies that prior errors can influence subsequent manipulation. Consequently, this benchmark is particularly relevant for assessing the robustness of intelligent robotic systems. The proposed benchmarking protocols and novel performance metric, based on a taxonomy of assembly complexity in conjunction with the comprehensive list of parts and their corresponding CAD models, serve as essential tools for research and development in the field. To provide a baseline, we evaluate the benchmark using traditional force-position control and report reliability and score metrics per primitive, subtask, assembly category, and subassembly. Accompanying data is available at https://irp-hka.github.io/robotic-assembly-benchmark/.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人学习在柔顺控制和机器人装配领域取得了显著进展。新方法的开发已超越处理抓取或插入等离散任务的能力，并发展到涵盖整个装配体的完整构建。传统基准主要聚焦单一任务，已不足以应对现代制造过程的复杂性和相互关联性。因此，涵盖更广泛装配与子装配步骤的基准需求日益明显。鉴于这些发展，我们提出LABIT，一个面向长时域操作的工业机器人装配基准。该基准涵盖DIN标准装配任务，包括拧紧、放置、插入和卡扣，且涉及高公差和低公差条件。这些装配步骤的连续性质意味着先前错误会影响后续操作。因此，该基准特别适用于评估智能机器人系统的鲁棒性。所提出的基准协议和基于装配复杂度分类法的新性能指标，连同全面的零件列表及其对应CAD模型，可作为该领域研究与开发的基础工具。为提供基线，我们使用传统力位控制评估该基准，并报告每个基元、子任务、装配类别和子装配的可靠性和得分指标。配套数据可在 https://irp-hka.github.io/robotic-assembly-benchmark/ 获取。

items.title_en: Symbol Rate Maximization in Rolling-Shutter OCC: Design and Implementation Considerations
items.abstract_en: Optical Camera Communication (OCC) systems can take advantage of the row-by-row scanning process of rolling-shutter cameras to capture the fast variations of light intensity coming from Visible Light Communication (VLC) LED-based transmitters. In order to study the maximum data rate that is feasible in such kind of OCC systems, this paper presents its equivalent digital communication system model in which the rolling-shutter camera is modeled as a rectangular matched-filter whose time width is equal to the exposure time of the camera, followed by a sampling process at the pixel row sweep rate of the camera. Based on the proposed rolling-shutter camera model, the maximum symbol rate that such OCC systems can support is experimentally demonstrated, and the impact of imperfect time synchronization between the VLC transmitter and the rolling-shutter OCC receiver is characterized in the form of Inter-Symbol Interference (ISI). The equivalent three-tap channel model that results from this process is experimentally validated and the generated ISI is compensated with the use of linear equalization in reception. Simulation and experimental results show a strong correlation between them, demonstrating that the proposed approach can be used to make the OCC system work at the Nyquist sampling rate, which is equivalent to the pixel row sweep rate of the rolling-shutter camera used in reception.
items.title_zh: 卷帘快门OCC中的符号速率最大化：设计与实现考量
items.abstract_zh: 光学相机通信（OCC）系统可利用卷帘快门相机的逐行扫描过程，捕获可见光通信（VLC）LED发射机光强的快速变化。为研究此类OCC系统可实现的最大数据速率，本文将卷帘快门相机等效为时间宽度等于曝光时间的矩形匹配滤波器，其后按相机像素行扫描速率进行采样，从而建立等效数字通信系统模型。基于该模型，实验验证了系统可支持的最大符号速率，并将VLC发射机与OCC接收机之间时间同步不完美的影响刻画为符号间干扰（ISI）。实验验证了由此得到的等效三抽头信道模型，并在接收端采用线性均衡补偿产生的ISI。仿真与实验结果高度吻合，表明该方法可使OCC系统工作在奈奎斯特采样速率，即接收所用卷帘快门相机的像素行扫描速率。
items.highlight_zh: 将卷帘快门相机建模为矩形匹配滤波器，实现奈奎斯特速率传输
items.digest_zh:
一、研究了什么问题：可见光通信中，用普通卷帘快门相机当接收机（即OCC）时，相机的逐行扫描恰好能记录LED光强的快速明暗变化。但这类系统的速率上限到底是多少、受什么限制，此前缺乏系统分析。

二、用了什么方法：作者把相机等效成通信系统中的“矩形匹配滤波器”——其积分时间就是相机曝光时间，之后以像素行扫描速率进行采样，从而得到一个可与经典数字通信理论对接的等效模型。在此模型下，作者实验测出了可支持的最大符号速率，并把发射端与接收端时间不同步造成的后果，统一刻画为符号间干扰（ISI），进而推出一个等效三抽头信道模型，并在接收端用线性均衡加以补偿。

三、有什么结果：仿真与实测结果高度一致，验证了三抽头信道模型的正确性；线性均衡能有效消除失配带来的ISI，使系统在奈奎斯特速率下工作，也就是恰好等于相机像素行扫描速率——即每个像素行承载一个符号，不留冗余。

四、为何重要：这给出了OCC系统速率设计的“理论天花板”与工程做法。过去设计者常靠降低速率来躲避同步误差，本文说明只要建模正确、接收端做均衡，就能把相机扫描速率用满，为高速相机通信的实用化提供了可操作的准则。

items.title_en: Scale Anchoring via Implicit Semantics and Sequence-Consistent Loop Closure for VGGT-Based SLAM
items.title_zh: 基于隐式语义与序列一致性回环闭合的VGGT SLAM尺度锚定
items.abstract_en: Feed-forward geometric foundation models enable dense monocular reconstruction without requiring camera calibration, but independently reconstructed submaps can accumulate scale drift, and even a valid revisit can yield an inconsistent cross-submap measurement. We extend VGGT-SLAM 2.0 with fixed-root scale anchoring and short-sequence-assisted direct loop connections. SALAD selects an image pair between the initial submap and each eligible new submap; joint VGGT inference then uses learned implicit semantic-geometric cues to supply a scale-only anchor while preserving the original overlap chain. For loop closure, neighboring image pairs support a consistency check and translation-scale alignment. Each accepted candidate contributes one robust Sim(3) factor between existing center-frame nodes, without an auxiliary loop submap. A 17-sequence comparison lowers mean Sim(3) ATE on nine TUM sequences from 0.1018 to 0.0451 m relative to the VGGT-SLAM 2.0 baseline. Anchoring improves all seven no-loop module ablations. On three Clio scenes, a fixed-loop comparison favors the direct connection pipeline over the tested auxiliary-submap pipeline. A separate candidate audit exposes additional rejections of visually overlapping pairs by the short-sequence check. These comparisons distinguish the gains from long-range scale anchoring and loop connection choices from the limitations of candidate verification.
items.abstract_zh: 前馈几何基础模型无需相机标定即可实现稠密单目重建，但独立重建的子图会累积尺度漂移，即使发生有效重访，也可能产生跨子图的不一致测量。我们在VGGT-SLAM 2.0中扩展了固定根尺度锚定和短序列辅助的直接回环连接。SALAD在初始子图与每个符合条件的新子图之间选择一对图像；随后联合VGGT推理利用学习到的隐式语义-几何线索提供仅尺度锚点，同时保留原始重叠链。对于回环闭合，相邻图像对支持一致性检查和翻译-尺度对齐。每个被接受的候选在现有中心帧节点之间贡献一个鲁棒的Sim(3)因子，而无需辅助回环子图。一项17序列比较显示，相对于VGGT-SLAM 2.0基线，在九个TUM序列上将平均Sim(3) ATE从0.1018 m降至0.0451 m。锚定改善了全部七个无回环模块消融。在三个Clio场景上，固定回环比较表明直接连接流程优于所测试的辅助子图流程。一项单独的候选审计揭示了短序列检查对视觉重叠图像对的额外拒绝。这些比较将长程尺度锚定和回环连接选择带来的增益与候选验证的局限性区分开来。

items.title_en: When to Probe and When to Act: Clarity-Aware Risk-Adaptive Control for Interactive Driving
items.title_zh: 何时探测、何时行动：面向交互式驾驶的清晰度感知风险自适应控制
items.abstract_en: Safe navigation in interactive traffic requires autonomous vehicles to reason about unobservable human characteristics and the reciprocal nature of multi-agent interactions. Traditional architectures often decouple prediction from planning, leading to the "Frozen Robot Problem" or unsafe maneuvers under high ambiguity because they treat risk assessment and information acquisition as independent objectives. We argue that the notion of safety should not remain static but must instead dynamically co-evolve with the system's internal confidence: the robot should actively clarify ambiguity when necessary while also recognizing the diminishing returns of information, and naturally transition toward task execution. We introduce a unified belief-space Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework that couples multistep information planning with a clarity-adaptive Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) barrier mechanism. By treating clarity, a scalar informational state, as an explicit planning variable, the controller co-designs its probing strategy with its safety specification, tightening conservatism under high ambiguity and relaxing constraints as confidence improves. We further provide a performance analysis showing that the cost of information seeking and the expected planning-cost gap to a controller that knows the true human characteristic are bounded by residual ambiguity and solver error. We evaluate the framework in lane-merging and unsignalized-intersection scenarios against representative interactive-planning baselines. Across 5,000 simulations, the proposed method achieves the highest success rates (94.6% and 93.2%) and the lowest collision rates (1.2% and 1.4%) among the compared methods, providing a principled foundation for robust decision-making in human-centric environments.
items.abstract_zh: 交互式交通中的安全导航要求自动驾驶车辆推理不可观测的人类特征以及多智能体交互的相互性。传统架构通常将预测与规划解耦，导致“冻结机器人问题”或高模糊性下的不安全机动，因为它们将风险评估和信息获取视为独立目标。我们认为，安全概念不应保持静态，而必须与系统内部置信度动态共同演化：机器人应在必要时主动澄清模糊性，同时认识到信息的收益递减，并自然过渡到任务执行。我们提出一个统一的信念空间模型预测控制（MPC）框架，将多步信息规划与清晰度自适应的条件风险价值（CVaR）屏障机制相耦合。通过将清晰度——一种标量信息状态——作为显式规划变量，控制器将其探测策略与安全规范协同设计，在高模糊性下收紧保守性，并随着置信度提高而放宽约束。我们进一步提供性能分析，表明信息寻求的成本以及相对于已知真实人类特征的控制器而言的期望规划成本差距，受残余模糊性和求解器误差界定。我们在车道汇入和无信号交叉口场景中，针对代表性交互规划基线评估该框架。在5,000次仿真中，所提方法在比较方法中取得最高成功率（94.6%和93.2%）和最低碰撞率（1.2%和1.4%），为以人为中心环境中的鲁棒决策提供了原则性基础。

items.title_en: FREE-LIVO: Physically Decoupled Yet Tightly Coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry
items.title_zh: FREE-LIVO：物理解耦但紧耦合的LiDAR-惯性-视觉里程计
items.abstract_en: LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) integrates complementary LiDAR, camera, and IMU measurements to achieve robust state estimation. However, most existing methods assume a fixed relative pose and accurate time synchronization between sensors. Toward modular and heterogeneous robotic systems, this paper presents FREE-LIVO, a tightly coupled odometry method that requires neither a rigid LiDAR-camera rig nor LiDAR-camera time synchronization. The proposed method uses a pretrained image feature matcher to establish correspondences between a camera image and a dense LiDAR intensity image generated from a single LiDAR scan using a generative model. From the resulting 3D point-to-pixel correspondences, we construct reprojection factors that directly constrain LiDAR and camera poses at different acquisition times. These factors are jointly optimized in a single factor graph together with constraints from point cloud registration, visual feature tracking, and the IMU measurements associated with each sensor. On six sequences from the public M3DGR dataset, FREE-LIVO achieves an average absolute trajectory error (ATE) RMSE of 0.45 m without provided LiDAR-camera extrinsic parameters and exhibits minimal accuracy degradation under time synchronization errors of up to 0.5 s. Furthermore, experiments with the LiDAR and camera mounted on separate robots demonstrate that the method can jointly estimate the trajectories of independently moving sensors.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR-惯性-视觉里程计（LIVO）集成互补的LiDAR、相机和IMU测量，以实现鲁棒状态估计。然而，大多数现有方法假设传感器之间具有固定相对位姿和精确时间同步。面向模块化和异构机器人系统，本文提出FREE-LIVO，一种既不需要刚性LiDAR-相机装置也不需要LiDAR-相机时间同步的紧耦合里程计方法。所提方法使用预训练图像特征匹配器，在相机图像与由单次LiDAR扫描通过生成模型生成的稠密LiDAR强度图像之间建立对应关系。根据得到的3D点到像素对应关系，我们构建重投影因子，直接约束不同采集时刻的LiDAR和相机位姿。这些因子在单一因子图中与来自点云配准、视觉特征跟踪以及各传感器相关IMU测量的约束一起联合优化。在公开M3DGR数据集的六个序列上，FREE-LIVO在未提供LiDAR-相机外参的情况下取得0.45 m的平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）RMSE，并在高达0.5 s的时间同步误差下表现出极小精度退化。此外，将LiDAR和相机安装在分离机器人上的实验表明，该方法能够联合估计独立运动传感器的轨迹。

items.title_en: WayTrace: A Map-to-Language-to-Trace Hierarchy for Embodied Urban Navigation
items.title_zh: WayTrace：面向具身城市导航的“地图到语言到轨迹”层次结构
items.abstract_en: Web services provide walking directions for nearly every city, but following them reliably over long routes remains challenging for autonomous robots. Point-goal navigation policies rely heavily on accurate GNSS, while most vision-language navigation models struggle to execute even short instructions outdoors. We present WayTrace, a hierarchical system that connects web-map directions to robot motion through language. An off-the-shelf orchestrator vision-language model reads the turn-by-turn directions, a satellite map and recent camera images, and issues one atomic language command at a time, such as "cross the road to the left". An onboard trace predictor, trained on over one million automatically labelled samples from street-level images, draws the path for this command in the image, and a reinforcement learning policy tracks it. In long-range simulated missions, WayTrace remains robust to GNSS noise and rarely leaves crosswalks or sidewalks, while point-goal baselines degrade sharply with about ten times more violations. Deployed on a wheeled-legged robot, WayTrace completes real-world missions of up to 1.37 km at about 1.1 m/s through a busy city centre, rural trails and a university campus, handling crosswalks, staircases and construction sites. Project page: https://way-trace.github.io
items.abstract_zh: Web服务几乎为每座城市提供步行导航，但自主机器人要在长路线上可靠遵循这些导航仍具挑战。点目标导航策略严重依赖精确GNSS，而大多数视觉-语言导航模型在户外甚至难以执行短指令。我们提出WayTrace，一种通过语言将网络地图导航连接到机器人运动的分层系统。一个现成的编排器视觉-语言模型读取逐向导航、卫星地图和近期相机图像，并一次发出一个原子语言命令，例如“向左穿过道路”。一个机载轨迹预测器在超过一百万来自街景图像的自动标注样本上训练，在图像中为该命令绘制路径，并由强化学习策略进行跟踪。在长距离仿真任务中，WayTrace对GNSS噪声保持鲁棒，很少离开人行横道或人行道，而点目标基线急剧退化，违规次数约多十倍。部署在轮腿机器人上，WayTrace以约1.1 m/s完成穿过繁忙市中心、乡村小径和大学校园、最长1.37 km的真实任务，处理人行横道、楼梯和施工场地。项目页面：https://way-trace.github.io

items.title_en: TAMPAgent: Agentic Belief-Space Planning for Mobile Manipulation
items.title_zh: TAMPAgent：面向移动操作的智能体式信念空间规划
items.abstract_en: Open-world robotic mobile manipulation requires acting in physical environments with only partial information. While recent Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) agents show strong open-world reasoning capabilities, existing architectures that rely on direct tool calling struggle with geometric uncertainty and thus are limited to fully-observable tabletop environments. In contrast, Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) systems can solve long-horizon tasks under partial observability but incur high computational costs and require closed worlds. We propose \textbf{TAMPAgent}, an agentic planning framework that unifies the reasoning of LVLMs with the structured constraint satisfaction of TAMP systems. We endow an LVLM agent with a belief-space planning model operating over an extensible API of perception, planning, and control tools. The agent formulates a partial task plan composed of parameterized observation and execution actions, which is subsequently completed using classical search algorithms. After extracting the plan's geometric constraints, the agent leverages its tool API to bind valid parameter values, satisfying feasibility requirements and producing an executable motion plan. Upon execution, the agent continuously updates its belief history and repeats this closed-loop process by interleaving observation and manipulation actions. Evaluated across complex household mobile manipulation tasks on Rainbow Y1 and Unitree G1 platforms, TAMPAgent significantly outperforms direct tool-calling agentic baselines, demonstrating that integrating TAMP constraint satisfaction into agentic planning loops is essential for unstructured, partially observable environments.
items.abstract_zh: 开放世界机器人移动操作要求仅凭部分信息在物理环境中行动。尽管近期大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）智能体展现出强大的开放世界推理能力，但依赖直接工具调用的现有架构难以应对几何不确定性，因而局限于完全可观测的桌面环境。相比之下，任务与运动规划（TAMP）系统可在部分可观测下求解长时程任务，但计算成本高且需要封闭世界。我们提出TAMPAgent，一种智能体式规划框架，将LVLM的推理与TAMP系统的结构化约束满足相统一。我们为LVLM智能体赋予一个信念空间规划模型，在感知、规划和控制的工具可扩展API上运行。该智能体制定由参数化观察和执行动作组成的部分任务计划，随后使用经典搜索算法完成。在提取计划的几何约束后，智能体利用其工具API绑定有效参数值，满足可行性要求并生成可执行的运动计划。在执行时，智能体持续更新其信念历史，并通过交错观察和操作动作重复这一闭环过程。在Rainbow Y1和Unitree G1平台上的复杂家庭移动操作任务中评估，TAMPAgent显著优于直接工具调用的智能体基线，表明将TAMP约束满足集成到智能体规划循环对于非结构化、部分可观测环境至关重要。

items.title_en: Visuo-tactile Diffusion Policy for Robotic Manipulation with Auxiliary Tactile Dynamics Prediction
items.title_zh: 面向机器人操作且带辅助触觉动力学预测的视触觉扩散策略
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon robotic assembly requires reliable perception and action across grasping, alignment, and insertion. Vision captures global object pose and scene context, where as fingertip touch provides local contact cues that are especially useful as contact states change. We present a visuotactile diffusion policy that combines four-step histories from two camera views and two fingertip tactile images to condition action-sequence generation. A recurrent temporal representation integrates recent observations from both modalities. To encourage it to capture how contact evolves under action, an auxiliary objective predicts fingertip-image changes two steps ahead from the temporal representation and demonstrated actions. This objective is used only during training and adds no inference-time computation. Across three independent training seeds in MuJoCo assembly experiments, the full model achieves an average success rate of $59.0\% \pm 2.6\%$, improving on the visual-only baseline ($42.7\% \pm 1.5\%$) by 16.3 percentage points.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程机器人装配需要在抓取、对齐和插入过程中实现可靠感知与动作。视觉捕获全局物体位姿和场景上下文，而指尖触觉提供局部接触线索，在接触状态变化时尤为有用。我们提出一种视触觉扩散策略，融合来自两个相机视角和两个指尖触觉图像的四步历史，以条件化动作序列生成。循环时间表示整合来自两种模态的近期观测。为促使它捕捉接触在动作下如何演化，一个辅助目标从时间表示和示范动作预测提前两步的指尖图像变化。该目标仅在训练期间使用，不增加推理时计算。在MuJoCo装配实验的三个独立训练种子中，完整模型达到平均成功率$59.0\% \pm 2.6\%$，相比仅视觉基线（$42.7\% \pm 1.5\%$）提高16.3个百分点。

items.title_en: Detector-Integrated Multi-Cue Association for Occlusion-Aware UAV Multi-Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向遮挡感知无人机多目标跟踪的检测器集成多线索关联
items.abstract_en: Multi-object tracking (MOT) in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenging because vehicles are small, visually similar, and frequently occluded, which leads to identity switches (IDSW). Appearance-based trackers such as DeepSORT rely on a standalone re-identification (ReID) network, whose per-target inference limits runtime speed, while the appearance of small or occluded vehicles remains unreliable. This paper proposes a detector-integrated multi-cue tracking framework. Lightweight projection heads are attached to the neck of the YOLOv8n detector to extract target embeddings through ROIAlign, producing detections and embeddings in a single forward pass. A multi-cue association cost then combines motion, IoU, and appearance distances with weights determined through ablation, complemented by low-score rescue and appearance-memory protection. On the UAVDT benchmark, the proposed method achieves a MOTA of 28.33, a HOTA of 31.16, and an IDF1 of 38.18 at 82.59 FPS, the best among the compared trackers in all three metrics, and reduces IDSW by 58.4\% compared with DeepSORT.
items.abstract_zh: 无人机（UAV）影像中的多目标跟踪（MOT）具有挑战性，因为车辆目标小、外观相似且经常被遮挡，从而导致身份切换（IDSW）。诸如DeepSORT等基于外观的跟踪器依赖独立的重新识别（ReID）网络，其逐目标推理限制了运行速度，而小型或被遮挡车辆的外观仍不可靠。本文提出一种探测器集成的多线索跟踪框架。将轻量级投影头附加到YOLOv8n探测器的颈部，通过ROIAlign提取目标嵌入，在单次前向传播中生成检测和嵌入。随后，多线索关联代价结合运动、IoU和外观距离，其权重通过消融实验确定，并辅以低分救援和外观记忆保护。在UAVDT基准上，所提方法在82.59 FPS下达到28.33的MOTA、31.16的HOTA和38.18的IDF1，在三个指标上均为对比跟踪器中最佳，并且与DeepSORT相比将IDSW减少了58.4%。

items.title_en: JARVIS: From Visual Manuals to Autonomous Robotic Assembly
items.title_zh: JARVIS：从视觉手册到自主机器人装配
items.abstract_en: Visual manuals communicate procedural knowledge through stepwise diagrams, but translating these instructions into reliable long-horizon robotic execution remains challenging. We introduce JARVIS, a method-agnostic benchmark for autonomous visual-manual-guided execution without additional language instructions. JARVIS comprises 236,679 LEGO assembly tasks across 8,987 scenes, with a carefully curated JARVIS-v1 suite of 50 tasks for interactive robotic evaluation. Tasks span varying initial structural complexities and assembly horizons, requiring agents to interpret manuals, ground actions in an evolving workspace, and execute the intended procedure. A structure-aware evaluation protocol captures geometric accuracy, structural relations, construction order, partial progress, and completion. We further introduce JARVIS-agentic, a tool-grounded embodied agent that composes robot primitives into executable programs and uses execution feedback for verification and recovery, without task-specific action trajectories or model parameter updates. Across nine multimodal and reasoning models, task-oriented primitives increase the average assembly score. Performance nevertheless declines sharply with assembly horizon, and execution errors remain difficult to correct. Prior-task experience improves initial performance, while repeated reflection provides inconsistent benefits, highlighting persistent limitations in connecting visual procedural reasoning with reliable physical execution.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉手册通过分步图示传达程序性知识，但将这些指令转化为可靠的长时程机器人执行仍然具有挑战性。我们提出JARVIS，一个与具体方法无关的基准，用于在无额外语言指令条件下进行自主的视觉手册引导执行。JARVIS包含8,987个场景中的236,679个LEGO装配任务，并配有精心策划的JARVIS-v1套件，包含50个用于交互式机器人评估的任务。任务涵盖不同的初始结构复杂度和装配时程，要求智能体解释手册、在不断变化的工作空间中将动作落地，并执行预期流程。结构感知评估协议捕捉几何精度、结构关系、装配顺序、部分进展和完成情况。我们进一步提出JARVIS-agentic，一种基于工具的具身智能体，它将机器人原语组合成可执行程序，并利用执行反馈进行验证和恢复，无需任务特定动作轨迹或模型参数更新。在九个多模态和推理模型上，面向任务的原语提高了平均装配得分。然而性能仍随装配时程增加而急剧下降，执行错误仍难以纠正。先前任务经验可提升初始性能，而重复反思带来的收益不一致，凸显了将视觉程序性推理与可靠物理执行相连接方面的持续局限。

items.title_en: DROID-SLAM in the Wild
items.title_zh: DROID-SLAM：在野外环境中
items.abstract_en: We present a robust, real-time RGB SLAM system that handles dynamic environments by leveraging differentiable Uncertainty-aware Bundle Adjustment. Traditional SLAM methods typically assume static scenes, leading to tracking failures in the presence of motion. Recent dynamic SLAM approaches attempt to address this challenge using predefined dynamic priors or uncertainty-aware mapping, but they remain limited when confronted with unknown dynamic objects or highly cluttered scenes where geometric mapping becomes unreliable. In contrast, our method estimates per-pixel uncertainty by exploiting multi-view visual feature inconsistency, enabling robust tracking and reconstruction even in real-world environments. The proposed system achieves state-of-the-art camera poses and scene geometry in cluttered dynamic scenarios while running in real time at around 10 FPS. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/DROID-W.git.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个鲁棒的实时RGB SLAM系统，通过利用可微的不确定性感知光束法平差来处理动态环境。传统SLAM方法通常假设静态场景，在存在运动时会导致跟踪失败。近期动态SLAM方法尝试使用预定义动态先验或不确定性感知建图来应对这一挑战，但在面对未知动态物体或高度杂乱、几何建图变得不可靠的场景时仍受限。相比之下，我们的方法利用多视图视觉特征不一致性估计逐像素不确定性，即使在真实世界环境中也能实现鲁棒跟踪与重建。所提出系统在杂乱的动态场景中实现最先进的相机位姿和场景几何，同时以约10 FPS实时运行。代码和数据集见 https://github.com/MoyangLi00/DROID-W.git。

items.title_en: Noise Mitigation Methods for Digital Visible Light Communication
items.title_zh: 数字可见光通信的噪声抑制方法
items.abstract_en: Visible Light Communication (VLC) using Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs) has gained attention due to its low power consumption, long lifetime, and fast response. However, VLC suffers from optical noise generated by ambient light sources such as fluorescent lamps, which leads to waveform distortion and increased bit error rates (BER). In this paper, we propose two noise reduction methods for Digital Visible Light Communication (DVLC) systems. The first method exploits the periodic nature of interference caused by AC-powered-line illumination and reduces interference by subtracting sampled noise waveforms from the received signal. Second, inspired by Active Noise Control (ANC) techniques, an additional photodiode is introduced for noise reception, and subtraction circuits are employed to attenuate noise in real time. Experimental results show that both methods improve BER performance compared with conventional receivers, with the ANC-inspired approach achieving superior performance under all tested conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 使用发光二极管（LED）的可见光通信（VLC）因其低功耗、长寿命和快速响应而受到关注。然而，VLC受到荧光灯等环境光源产生的光学噪声影响，导致波形失真和误码率（BER）升高。本文针对数字可见光通信（DVLC）系统提出两种降噪方法。第一种方法利用交流供电线路照明所造成干扰的周期性，通过从接收信号中减去采样噪声波形来降低干扰。第二种方法受主动噪声控制（ANC）技术启发，引入额外光电二极管接收噪声，并采用减法电路实时衰减噪声。实验结果表明，与常规接收机相比，两种方法均改善了BER性能，其中受ANC启发的方法在所有测试条件下取得更优性能。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cl
items.title_en: Generalized-CVO: Fast and Correspondence-Free Local Point Cloud Registration with Second Order Riemannian Optimization
items.title_zh: Generalized-CVO：基于二阶黎曼优化的快速无对应局部点云配准
items.abstract_en: We propose a fast and correspondence-free local point cloud registration method that leverages geometric surface structure and reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) embeddings. The method represents point clouds as continuous functions with point-wise anisotropic kernels that encode local geometry. This formulation improves alignment along surface normals while relaxing alignment along tangential directions. To solve the resulting registration problem, we propose a second-order on-manifold optimization scheme with approximate Riemannian Hessians, achieving a speedup of up to 10x over the first-order solvers used in prior correspondence-free RKHS-based methods. We demonstrate improved frame-to-frame LiDAR and RGB-D tracking accuracy across diverse indoor and outdoor datasets. On a LiDAR tracking registration task in the driving domain, we achieve a reduction of >55% in both translational and rotational drift in challenging feature-sparse environments. On object registration benchmarks, we show improved robustness over ICP-based methods and further gains when refining global initialization, particularly under moderate misalignment.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种快速且无对应的局部点云配准方法，利用几何表面结构和再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）嵌入。该方法将点云表示为具有逐点各向异性核的连续函数，以编码局部几何。该形式在沿表面法线方向改善对齐，同时放宽沿切线方向的对齐。为求解所得配准问题，我们提出一种在流形上的二阶优化方案，采用近似黎曼Hessian，相比先前基于RKHS的无对应方法所使用的一阶求解器，实现最高10倍加速。我们在多种室内和室外数据集上展示了帧到帧LiDAR和RGB-D跟踪精度的提升。在驾驶领域的LiDAR跟踪配准任务中，我们在具有挑战性的特征稀疏环境中将平移和旋转漂移均降低>55%。在物体配准基准上，我们相较基于ICP的方法展现出更高鲁棒性，并在细化全局初始化时获得进一步提升，尤其是在中等程度失配下。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:An Efficient Token Compression Framework for Visual Object T
items.title_en: An Efficient Token Compression Framework for Visual Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向视觉目标跟踪的高效令牌压缩框架
items.abstract_en: Refining visual representations by eliminating their internal feature-level redundancy is crucial for simultaneously optimizing the performance and computational cost of models in visual tracking. To enhance their performance, many contemporary Transformer-based trackers leverage a larger number of historical template frames to capture richer spatio-temporal cues. However, this strategy leads to a massive number of input visual tokens. This creates two critical issues: it imposes a quadratic computational burden and can also degrade the tracker's overall performance. To bridge this gap, we propose a compress-then-interact tracking framework, ETCTrack, that learns to efficiently compress template tokens from historical template frames into a robust target representation, moving beyond handcrafted rules. Our method first employs the Adaptive Token Compressor to dynamically construct compact yet highly discriminative template tokens by filtering out redundant visual tokens. These refined template tokens are then processed by our Hierarchical Interaction Encoder to achieve a deep, adaptive interaction with the search features. Refined search features ensure subsequent precise target localization. Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art trackers. ETCTrack-B224 reduces the number of template tokens by 60%, leading to a 21.4% reduction in MACs with only a 0.4% drop in accuracy. The source code are available at https://github.com/PJD-WJ/ETCTrack.
items.abstract_zh: 通过消除视觉表示内部的特征级冗余来精炼视觉表示，对于同时优化视觉跟踪模型的性能和计算成本至关重要。为提升性能，许多当代基于Transformer的跟踪器利用更多历史模板帧以捕获更丰富的时空线索。然而，该策略导致输入视觉令牌数量巨大，带来两个关键问题：造成二次计算负担，并可能降低跟踪器整体性能。为弥补这一差距，我们提出一种“先压缩后交互”的跟踪框架ETCTrack，它学习将历史模板帧中的模板令牌高效压缩为鲁棒的目标表示，超越手工规则。我们的方法首先采用自适应令牌压缩器（Adaptive Token Compressor），通过滤除冗余视觉令牌来动态构建紧凑且高度判别性的模板令牌。这些精炼后的模板令牌随后由分层交互编码器（Hierarchical Interaction Encoder）处理，以与搜索特征实现深度自适应交互。精炼后的搜索特征确保后续精确目标定位。在七个基准上的实验表明，我们的方法优于当前最先进的跟踪器。ETCTrack-B224将模板令牌数量减少60%，使MACs降低21.4%，而精度仅下降0.4%。源代码见 https://github.com/PJD-WJ/ETCTrack。

items.title_en: Smart Visual Beacons with Asynchronous Optical Communications using Event Cameras
items.abstract_en: Event cameras are bio-inspired dynamic vision sensors that respond to changes in image intensity with a high temporal resolution, high dynamic range and low latency. These sensor characteristics are ideally suited to enable visual target tracking in concert with a broadcast visual communication channel for smart visual beacons with applications in distributed robotics. Visual beacons can be constructed by high-frequency modulation of Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs) such as vehicle headlights, Internet of Things (IoT) LEDs, smart building lights, etc., that are already present in many real-world scenarios. The high temporal resolution characteristic of the event cameras allows them to capture visual signals at far higher data rates compared to classical frame-based cameras. In this paper, we propose a novel smart visual beacon architecture with both LED modulation and event camera demodulation algorithms. We quantitatively evaluate the relationship between LED transmission rate, communication distance and the message transmission accuracy for the smart visual beacon communication system that we prototyped. The proposed method achieves up to 4 kbps in an indoor environment and lossless transmission over a distance of 100 meters, at a transmission rate of 500 bps, in full sunlight, demonstrating the potential of the technology in an outdoor environment.
items.title_zh: 使用事件相机的异步光通信智能视觉信标
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机是受生物启发的动态视觉传感器，以高时间分辨率、高动态范围和低延迟响应图像强度变化。这些传感器特性非常适合与广播式视觉通信信道协同实现视觉目标跟踪，用于应用于分布式机器人的智能视觉信标。视觉信标可通过高频调制发光二极管（LED）构建，例如车辆前照灯、物联网（IoT）LED、智能建筑灯等，这些LED已存在于许多现实场景中。事件相机的高时间分辨率特性使其能够以远高于经典基于帧相机的数据速率捕获视觉信号。本文提出一种新颖的智能视觉信标架构，兼具LED调制和事件相机解调算法。我们定量评估了所原型开发的智能视觉信标通信系统中LED传输速率、通信距离与消息传输准确率之间的关系。所提方法在室内环境中达到最高4 kbps，并在全日照下以500 bps的传输速率实现100米距离的无损传输，展示了该技术在室外环境中的潜力。

items.title_en: E-VLC: A Real-World Dataset for Event-based Visible Light Communication And Localization
items.abstract_en: Optical communication using modulated LEDs (e.g., visible light communication) is an emerging application for event cameras, thanks to their high spatio-temporal resolutions. Event cameras can be used simply to decode the LED signals and also to localize the camera relative to the LED marker positions. However, there is no public dataset to benchmark the decoding and localization in various real-world settings. We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first public dataset that consists of an event camera, a frame camera, and ground-truth poses that are precisely synchronized with hardware triggers. It provides various camera motions with various sensitivities in different scene brightness settings, both indoor and outdoor. Furthermore, we propose a novel method of localization that leverages the Contrast Maximization framework for motion estimation and compensation. The detailed analysis and experimental results demonstrate the advantages of LED-based localization with events over the conventional AR-marker--based one with frames, as well as the efficacy of the proposed method in localization. We hope that the proposed dataset serves as a future benchmark for both motion-related classical computer vision tasks and LED marker decoding tasks simultaneously, paving the way to broadening applications of event cameras on mobile devices. https://woven-visionai.github.io/evlc-dataset

items.title_en: VisionSIM: Beyond Idealized Sensors - A Multi-Modal Simulator for Robot Perception
items.title_zh: VisionSIM：超越理想化传感器——面向机器人感知的多模态仿真器
items.abstract_en: Robotic perception increasingly relies on heterogeneous sensor suites combining cameras with emerging modalities (event, SPAD, iToF/dToF, and thermal). Yet existing simulators idealize these sensors, hiding critical modality-specific failure modes that limit real-world deployment. We present VisionSIM, a unified, physically grounded simulation platform that elevates sensor realism to a first-class concern by modeling the raw physical measurement process for diverse conventional and emerging modalities. We expose fine-grained control over physical sensor parameters, reproducing failure modes overlooked by general-purpose simulators: pileup and glare for LiDAR; phase wrapping, saturation, and motion artifacts for iToF; refractory drops for event cameras; and history-dependent emission for thermal cameras. This enables principled cross-modality comparison on identical scenes and trajectories. We release the platform and a large indoor dataset with synchronized raw measurements and rich ground-truth annotations.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人感知日益依赖异构传感器套件，将相机与新兴模态（事件、SPAD、iToF/dToF和热成像）相结合。然而，现有仿真器将这些传感器理想化，掩盖了限制现实世界部署的关键模态特定失效模式。我们提出VisionSIM，一个统一的、基于物理的仿真平台，通过对多种传统和新兴模态的原始物理测量过程建模，将传感器真实性提升为首要关注点。我们提供对物理传感器参数的细粒度控制，复现通用仿真器忽略的失效模式：LiDAR的堆积和眩光；iToF的相位卷绕、饱和与运动伪影；事件相机的不应期丢事件；以及热成像相机的历史相关发射。这使得能够在相同场景和轨迹上进行有原则的跨模态比较。我们发布该平台以及一个大型室内数据集，包含同步的原始测量和丰富的真值标注。

items.title_en: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
items.title_zh: PrimeSim：基于大规模跨具身演示的通用世界模型仿真器
items.abstract_en: A robot world model that serves as a simulator must do more than generate plausible videos: it must faithfully follow commanded actions, maintain consistency across camera views, and sustain coherent long-horizon rollouts. We present PrimeSim, an action-conditioned, multiview world model simulator that addresses these challenges through progressive midtraining and posttraining. Starting from a pretrained video generator, we midtrain on 30,110 hours of robot demonstrations spanning 22 platforms. To improve action following, we introduce a unified cross-embodiment action representation and frame-aligned dual-path conditioning to strengthen action-frame correspondence. To maintain multiview consistency, we develop view-aware interleaved attention with explicit camera identities, enabling cross-view information exchange while preserving view-specific representations. We further introduce a fast-video, slow-memory posttraining framework that transforms the bidirectional video generator into an efficient autoregressive simulator. By combining fast causal generation, self-rollout training, and hierarchical temporal memory, PrimeSim mitigates error accumulation from self-generated histories and supports coherent long-horizon simulation. PrimeSim runs at 10.1 FPS, remains stable over long-horizon rollouts on rigid and deformable manipulation tasks, and transfers to held-out platforms within 100 to 200 gradient steps where the pretrained backbone does not. Against five open-source action-conditioned world models it leads four of the five WorldSimProbe suites and posts the best overall EWMBench score, while fine-grained local calibration still trails the field; its rollouts are faithful enough to support GRPO-based policy optimization. We release the model weights, inference code, and training code.
items.abstract_zh: 作为仿真器的机器人世界模型不能仅生成看似合理的视频：它必须忠实遵循指令动作，保持跨相机视图的一致性，并维持连贯的长时程推演。我们提出PrimeSim，一种动作条件化的多视图世界模型仿真器，通过渐进式中训练和后训练应对这些挑战。从预训练视频生成器出发，我们在涵盖22个平台的30,110小时机器人演示上进行中训练。为改进动作遵循，我们引入统一的跨具身动作表示和帧对齐双路径条件化，以增强动作与帧的对应关系。为保持多视图一致性，我们开发具有显式相机身份标识的视图感知交错注意力，在保留视图特定表示的同时实现跨视图信息交换。我们进一步引入快视频、慢记忆的后训练框架，将双向视频生成器转变为高效的自回归仿真器。通过结合快速因果生成、自推演训练和分层时间记忆，PrimeSim减轻了来自自生成历史的误差累积，并支持连贯的长时程仿真。PrimeSim以10.1 FPS运行，在刚性和可变形操作任务的长时程推演中保持稳定，并能在100至200个梯度步内迁移到留出平台，而预训练主干无法做到。与五个开源动作条件化世界模型相比，它在五个WorldSimProbe套件中的四个上领先，并取得最佳整体EWMBench分数，而细粒度局部校准仍落后于该领域；其推演足够忠实，可支持基于GRPO的策略优化。我们发布模型权重、推理代码和训练代码。
